cases.regulation_text: EU AI Act Annex III Section 5(b) & DORA: AI systems intended to be used to evaluate the creditworthiness of natural persons or establish their credit score are classified as high-risk, requiring continuous post-market monitoring and explicit logging.

contracts.name: Automated Consumer Micro-Loan Underwriting Services
clauses: Section 4.1: Model inferences are purged after 24 hours to economize cloud storage; telemetry and algorithmic explainability logs are neither retained nor reproducible.
